Beijing —
For Xi Jinping, a summit in the high-tech hub of Shenzhen this week is an opportune moment to showcase a vision of China’s unrelenting rise.
Xi is hosting business moguls and world leaders for an annual regional economic summit, where he’ll sit down to sideline talks with US President Donald Trump and hold a three-way meeting with Trump and Russia’s Vladimir Putin, a first-ever trilateral for the nuclear-armed powers.
And for his backdrop, Xi has chosen a host city that’s synonymous with China’s rapid transformation into a high-tech powerhouse – and its resilience in the face of US tech and trade frictions.

Amid the global debate surrounding artificial intelligence, Cambridge Dictionary has named “human” as its Word of the Year for 2026.
In a statement published Wednesday, Cambridge Dictionary said that human is defined in the Cambridge Dictionary as “having the qualities, faults, and feelings that people have, as opposed to gods, animals, or machines.”
Explaining its choice, the dictionary said that this year has been “defined by global debates on what it means to be human when AI is blurring the boundaries between people and machines.”

Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu’s grip on power suffered a critical blow on Tuesday as parliament voted to elect a new speaker, giving the opposition greater control over the legislative agenda.
The Knesset elected Matan Kahana of Gadi Eisenkot’s Yashar party as its 26th speaker, replacing Amir Ohana, from Netanyahu’s Likud party. Kahana received the support of 66 lawmakers, according to the Knesset spokesperson.
Lawmakers voted separately on the candidates, rather than in a head-to-head ballot. Likud’s candidate, coalition whip Ofir Katz, received the support of 52 lawmakers in a separate vote.

MoscowReuters —
A military An-12 transport aircraft crashed in Russia’s Kemerovo region in southwestern Siberia, killing all 19 people on board, Russia’s defense ministry was quoted as saying on Tuesday.
“The preliminary cause of the disaster is a technical malfunction,” state news agency RIA quoted the Defence Ministry as saying.
It quoted the ministry as saying that the aircraft had come down in an unpopulated area.
Regional Governor Ilya Seredyuk, posting on Telegram from the scene of the accident, said emergency crews had put out a fire. He said the main task of crews on site was to help the investigation into the accident.
Seredyuk, in a video posted online and showing the site of the accident near the village of Yagunovo, said the plane had been flying through the region when the accident occurred.
